prompt: Create ONE clear flat 2D school educational drawing of a pair of FOOTWEAR BOOTS made entirely of transparent GLASS. Catalan target BOTES + VIDRE means GLASS BOOTS worn on FEET, NOT glass jars. Each boot must have a tall ankle shaft, rounded toe pointing forward, sole and low heel. Show them in side/three-quarter view so the L-shaped FOOTWEAR silhouette is obvious. Transparent glass edges and highlights. No jars, bottles, containers, people or other objects. White background, complete pair centered with broad white margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Friendly readable classroom material.
review: Botes de calçat de vidre corregides: canya, puntera, sola i taló clars; parell complet.
